prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a four-legged bronze automaton sentinel seen from the side, built like a mechanical hound: a long low horizontal body of riveted bronze plates carried on exactly four jointed metal legs, two at the front and two at the back, all four feet flat on the ground; a small domed head at the front with one round glowing red lens eye, two jointed arms on the chest each ending in a short spear blade, both held pointing down in front of it close to the body, the same two spear blades in every cell; weathered bronze with green patina spots; the whole machine sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: one round glowing red lens eye in the domed head.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, leaning forward and stabbing both spear arms down toward the heroes just in front of its front feet, the lens glowing brighter, all four feet on the ground, the spear tips well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back low, the body dropped and hunched with all four feet flat on the ground (no rearing up, the front legs down), no taller than its idle height, the head ducked, the lens dimmed, the two spear arms pulled in close under the chest, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the body but keep all four legs on the ground and the body low (no leap, no rearing up): thrust the two spear arms toward the heroes with the joints bent, so the spear tips stay well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no sparks, steam, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, two eyes, a face, a cannon, wheels, wings, a rider, flesh, steam, sparks, two legs, standing upright, a round egg body.
